description: The Lectric XP4 is the latest iteration of the XP model, a pillar in the eBike industry beloved by more than 450,000 riders. Built for both fun and function, the eagerly anticipated XP4 carries on the tradition of being the ultimate eBike for anything you want to do! It’s packed with upgrades for maximum performance and still comes “travel-size” so you can fold, pack, and go! Now with an in-house-designed torque sensor for smoother power distribution and a better riding experience, the XP4 includes a fully redesigned frame, new colors, a full-color TFT display, new 602 hydraulic brakes, in addition to a new option for an upgraded, more powerful 750-watt motor version and a longer-range 17.5Ah battery for up to 85 miles of range so you’ll never run out of fun!

components.description: Get ultimate stopping power with 602 hydraulic brakes paired with 180mm rotors (2.3mm thick), making it as easy to stop as it is to go, whether in wet or dry conditions. Paired with ergonomically designed aluminum brake levers for durability.
11-32 tooth, 8-speed freewheel
A KMC Z8 steel chain with inner plate chamfering offers consistent tension and smooth transitions between shifting for a secure performance throughout your ride.
Forged aluminum, 56-tooth custom chainring is the perfect ratio for effortless 20-inch wheel pedaling.
Shimano Altus derailleur

An integrated & removable 48V, 10.4Ah (500Wh) lithium-ion battery certified to UL 2271 makes for a clean design while powering your ride for up to 50 miles on a single charge.** The XP4 is also certified to UL 2849.† Removing the battery from the frame is a breeze with the side-facing key port location.

An auxiliary charging port near the bottom bracket provides riders with the option to charge the eBike without removing the battery. The XP4 comes standard with a 2amp charger for 4-6 hour charging, but a 5amp Fast Charger can be purchased separately, which can charge the standard battery in as little as 2 hours.
A 500W rear hub motor (1092W peak) with 55Nm of torque supplies power and speed quicker than ever before. Stealth M24 technology delivers a quieter motor experience without sacrificing power.

A custom color TFT display featuring a detachable mount and a USB-C port. You’ll find trip, battery, & power intelligence on the go. New intuitive drop-down menus make navigating the settings on your eBike easy to understand & allow users to customize their ride settings based on preference. The IP-X5-rated display ensures greater water resistance.
20amp internal controller is IP-X5 rated and potted for weatherproofing and thermal management.
Polypropylene fenders with a flared tail protect you and your ride from debris. The flexible material is damage-resistant and helps ensure long-term durability.
The front fork provides shock absorption for a smooth and comfortable ride. Adjust the tension or lock it out to tailor each ride to your preference based on payload capacity and weight distribution.
Full-length ergonomic lock-on grips add comfort so you can ride longer. The plastic sleeve inside helps lock the grips into place and also allows the grips to be easily removed.
A heavy-duty steel side-sweeping kickstand located near the chainstay keeps the eBike upright.

An integrated safety system, featuring a new bright 90-lumen headlamp with side amber lights and a brake-activated rear light powered by the internal battery, allows you to be seen at any time of day.
Alert drivers, riders, and people nearby with our turn signals. Simply use the left or right arrows on the button pad to turn on the blinkers on either side of the rear light.

Custom-designed 6000 Series Aluminum quick-release pedals with splined inserts allow for easy, tool-free removal and installation. The new shape of the pedals improves foot traction for an optimal experience.

A new rear rack design integrated into the bike frame holds up to 150lbs and features bosses for mounting various accessory combinations. Add a LevelUp Rack (sold separately) on top of the rack to unlock even more accessory combinations!
A custom-designed saddle complements a sporty look while adding comfort so you can ride longer.
Customize the bike to your perfect size by adjusting the seat post height; simply open the quick-release collar and slide the post to your preferred height and lock it in place by closing the collar.

Our proprietary in-house-designed torque sensor programming will give you smoother power distribution and a better riding experience. It is designed to manage power output based on the rider’s pedaling effort. With this programming experience, riders can reach higher speeds easily and with more control than ever before.
below-the-bar trigger shifter

Ride longer and more comfortably in an upright cruising position with our new zero-degree stem, which shortens the handlebar reach. Plus, telescoping functionality allows riders to reach a wide range of heights while maintaining comfort and stability.
An ergonomic below-the-bar trigger throttle on the left-hand side is easily engaged with your thumb while simultaneously eliminating joint fatigue.

Puncture-resistant 20” x 3” tires are perfect for mixed terrains and make for a smoother ride. The new custom tread pattern has less rolling resistance for better power efficiency and delivers an ultra-quiet experience. Slime is installed to prevent flat tires—at no additional cost.
